extra.//: Where CFPI looks for FRCDE, baked into the published bundle so a colleague opening the shared link only has to sign in. No trailing slash. Settings still overrides it on-device for local development.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CFPI records your route along the drain to confirm the full stretch was inspected.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: CFPI keeps recording your route while the screen is off or you are using another app, so an inspection is never lost mid-walk.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CFPI attaches photographs of defects to the inspection record.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: CFPI saves inspection photographs to your device.
